evidence.title: Rombo | Animation library for Tailwind CSS Library
GitHub - romboHQ/tailwindcss-motion: tailwindcss-motion is a Tailwind CSS Plugin made at RomboHQ. It's a simple, yet powerful, animation library with a simple syntax. · GitHub

name: tailwindcss-motion
summary: Tailwind CSS plugin that animates any element with simple utility classes and presets instead of custom keyframes.
description: npm-installable, MIT-licensed Tailwind CSS plugin: instead of defining custom keyframes you animate elements inline with utility classes (motion-translate-x-in-25, motion-opacity-in-0) or presets such as motion-preset-fade. The page includes an inline visual animator with presets and settings, plus installation and documentation for the plugin.
contains: Tailwind CSS plugin installed with npm i -D tailwindcss-motion
utility classes and presets to animate any element without keyframes
inline visual animator with presets and settings
Chrome extension exports animations as Tailwind classes, pure CSS or Framer Motion code
